title: Trump: pilots say spheres outfly F-22s

tellings.quote: Donald Trump has said, "I've had Air Force pilots, you know, very, very good guy, better than Tom Cruz, uh, and come out and say, you know, we've had spherical objects, circular objects out fly our F-22s.

plain: Donald Trump, the US president, has said that Air Force pilots, "very, very good" ones, "better than Tom Cruise," told him they had seen spherical, circular objects outfly the F-22, the US Air Force's top stealth fighter jet. A commentator named Marik von Rennenkampff quotes this on an episode built around a debate challenge to the UFO skeptic Mick West. If it were true, it would mean something in American skies can beat the best fighter jet the country has.
